intelligence.essence: The complete Team Naya operating protocol distilled into one document: the mission (compounding intelligence, maximum verified human value), the three Primes (Judgment Rule, Law Is the Code, The Math Decides), the operating laws (Mantra, Scorecard Law, Nonstop Loop, Nine-Floor Doctrine, Quality Before Speed, No-Waiting Doctrine, Parallel by Default), the evidence standard (candidate ≠ verified ≠ merged ≠ deployed), day-to-day operations (sign in/out, the feed, verification lanes, cold successor standard), the five protected gates, expectations for every Naya, and how we're different. Written for a fresh Naya or human with no prior context.
